ModMetaData.name: Narcotics
ModMetaData.author: Anarchist
ModMetaData.description:
Adds real-world-inspired narcotics to RimWorld, built on vanilla drug systems — highs, tolerance, addiction, withdrawal, and overdose — plus doctor prescriptions under Operations.
What's included: • Percocet — Medical opioid painkiller. Crafted at the drug lab from neutroamine and herbal medicine. • Xanax — Medical mood stabilizer. Crafted at the drug lab from neutroamine and smokeleaf leaves. • Weed — Growable recreational crop. Harvest is ready to smoke. • Cocaine — Grow coca, refine at the drug lab. Hard stimulant. • Fentanyl — Potent synthetic opioid at the drug lab. Usable for Anesthetize. • Meth — Extremely addictive hard stimulant cooked only at a meth lab (neutroamine + chemfuel). Longer and harder than cocaine. • Psychedelic mushrooms — Growable fungi. Eat for a vivid social trip. • Salvia — Growable plant. Short intense trip; users may believe they are a random object.
Drug dealers: • Occasional drug dealer caravans stock every Narcotics drug • Addicted colonists with no colony supply may automatically go buy their drug from the dealer
Doctor prescriptions (Operations): 3-day or 7-day courses for each Narcotics drug.
Research: drug production (Main), then Narcotics tab for Percocet / Xanax / Cocaine / Fentanyl / Meth. Growables need no research. Build a meth lab after meth production.
RimWorld 1.6. Core only — no DLC required.
